shape_hint: Cylindrical head with a hexagon socket on top, under it a long, precisely ground unthreaded cylindrical shoulder of diameter ds (larger than the thread), and at the end a much shorter, smaller thread of diameter d and length b (with a small relief groove between shoulder and thread). The nominal length is the shoulder length (under head to shoulder end), not the overall length.

role_map.ds: nominal shoulder diameter (tolerance f9, DIN 7379 h8)
role_map.b_max: thread length max (b min = b - 0.25 for M6/M8, b - 0.4 for M12/M16)

notes: Only M6, M8, M12, M16 are published because for M5, M10, M20 the market shows two incompatible shoulder diameters (6/12/24 vs the ISO nominal 6.5/13/25). The catalog owner must decide the d1 series for M5/M10/M20 himself (Ganter states the official ISO 7379 sheet is 6.5-M5 / 13-M10 / 25-M20; M3 d1=4 and M4 d1=5 exist only in the older DIN 9841-type series). Shoulder length (the ordering length, about 6..200 mm) is not in this table. Property class 12.9, shoulder tolerance f9 (DIN 7379: h8). KS B 1104 and ASME B18.3 shoulder screws were not tabulated. nfgab.com lists d1 as 6/8/10/12/16/20/24 and marks it 'Not according to ISO 7379' (vendor footnote), which supports the ISO sheet being 6.5/13/25 for M5/M10/M20, but a third table source for 6.5/13/25 was not found, so those rows stay dropped.

Clusters per column (min over rows): ds 6, dk 6, k_max 6, s 6, b 3 (FR, GA, MU; VI adds M6/M8), P 2 (CN, FR) +EH page = 3, b_max 2 (CN + theo unlabeled 'b'), t_min 2 (CN + nfgab). No numeric dissent on any kept cell (vidasan k M10 8.9 / vidasan dk = knurled 13.27 are not votes).

P: in-family only CN + fastenright (2); the third vote is engineeringhardware.com, whose pitch column is right but whose k column (k = d) mixes DIN 9841 and was excluded by the producer; P is a coarse-thread property (M6 1, M8 1.25, M12 1.75, M16 2 confirmed in all other families). Kept, but weakest column; drop if strict in-family counting is required.

b (nominal thread length) is read from 'l2' (ganter, pass) / 'L2' (fastenright) - no textual definition on the pages, role identified by ISO 7379 symbol convention (l1 shoulder length, l2 thread length, l3 head height in the Ganter header) and by equality with the midpoint of CN b max/min (11.25/10.75 -> 11); only vidasan prints a plain 'b' (M6 11, M8 13). Three clusters agree, flagged as inferred-by-symbol.

ganter, fastenright, pass-schulterschrauben, vidasan, nfgab all carry the 6/12/24 mm shoulder series for M5/M10/M20 (non-ISO 6.5/13/25), suggesting one catalogue origin; harmless for kept rows (M6, M8, M12, M16 identical in both series). Rows M5/M10/M20 correctly dropped.
ds is the nominal (f9) shoulder diameter; dk is the PLAIN head diameter max (knurled 13.27/16.27/24.33/30.33 not used); k_max/s fine.
